_note: The reference voice for Chatterbox sample A: two consecutive utterances from one recording session of the Thorsten-Voice dataset, joined with 0.35 s of silence (the dataset has no single 10-15 s utterance), trimmed, loudness-normalised to -20 LUFS, mono 24 kHz.
